title: A genuine response without owed gratitude

captions.physics: Ending an automatic claim of attention
captions.energy: Returning to important meaning genuinely heard

meaning: You can end an automatic claim of attention and return to important meaning, noticing when a renewed response starts requiring gratitude in return.
text: Death in the physical position of your Vishuddha appears in ending automatic confirmation of attention. Judgement in energy supports a wish to return to important meaning genuinely heard and renew an answer to a request. The Devil in emotions brings attachment to recognition in return. You can sincerely want to listen better while expecting the effort to be appreciated. These aspects differ: the renewed response concerns the question, while desired gratitude has not yet been promised.

For example, you stop saying “Yes, yes, I am listening” while mentally preparing your own reply. You return to a request not to interrupt with conclusions and directly name what you now understand. **Renewed attention creates no debt of gratitude**. You can hear the story continue instead of awaiting immediate praise for a changed exchange. Another clarification in reply need not cancel your effort. The request’s actual meaning matters rather than proof that new participation immediately brought the emotional return wanted.

The knot tightens if absent gratitude becomes an argument for restoring the old response. Renewal then depends on a reward assigned beforehand. Constructive Judgement helps respond again to what matters instead of replacing it with assessment of your own involvement. You can directly say that recognition is precious and hear an actual answer; honest change requires neither endless proof of effort nor compulsory confirmation that everything is already well.
